plugins.cameraPermission: TMK uses the camera to photograph your ID and take a selfie for identity verification, proof of residence for an area change, and, for staff, to scan event passes and membership cards at check-in.
plugins.photosPermission: TMK lets you choose a photo of your ID or proof of residence when you cannot use the camera.
plugins.microphonePermission: TMK uses the microphone only when you tap Speak instead, to turn your words into text on your phone. No recording is kept or sent.
